decisions.question: For supplied Qty: 2 / Price: 18,000 or Longyi x2 18000 formats, is the amount consistently a unit price?
decisions.answer: It depends on the shop or message
decisions.rule: When quantity exceeds one and no explicit per-unit or total meaning is stated, unit_price stays null with an ambiguity label. Keep a price attached to exactly one item: unit and line amount are identical without division. Do not infer a missing quantity or divide totals.

decisions.question: Should correction text also be kept in the note after correcting the field?
decisions.rule: Apply phone/address corrections to the field without copying correction text into note. Keep separately stated fulfillment instructions.
